description: Use for an anonymous current price preview once ride facts are complete; get_service_options gives required facts and timeZone. Do not include contact details. No offer, reservation, message, charge or availability guarantee is created. If the customer explicitly requests an offer, use prepare_offer; an existing offer is read with get_offer_status.

locale.description: Response language: de (German, default) or en (English).

ride.description: Complete ride facts for a transfer, return transfer or hourly service. Distinct pickup/destination and valid local dates/times are required.

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD in the provider timeZone returned by get_service_options; resolve relative dates first.

destination.description: Destination distinct from pickup, with city/municipality or postcode; e.g. München Hauptbahnhof, 80335 München. For hourly service describe the planned route or As directed.

flightNumber.description: Optional flight number for the airport ride, such as LH123; at most 240 characters.

hours.description: Booked hourly-service duration, integer 1–24 hours; required with serviceType=hourly and forbidden for transfers.

luggage.description: Optional luggage count/type or fit requirements, at most 240 characters; unusual luggage may require review.

passengers.description: Total passenger count, integer 1–60; vehicle requirements and acceptance are evaluated separately.

pickup.description: Pickup address or named place with city/municipality or postcode; e.g. Flughafen München (MUC), 85356 München-Flughafen.

returnDate.description: Return service date YYYY-MM-DD; required only when tripType=return. The return must follow the outbound pickup.

returnTime.description: Return pickup local HH:mm in the same provider timeZone; required only when tripType=return. Omit both return fields for one_way.

serviceType.description: Set hourly only for chauffeur service booked by duration; omit for transfers. Hourly requires tripType=one_way and hours.

time.description: Local pickup time in 24-hour HH:mm format, in the provider timeZone (Samuelz: Europe/Berlin); not UTC or an offset timestamp.

tripType.description: one_way for a single transfer or hourly service; return for outbound plus a separate later return transfer, requiring returnDate and returnTime.

specialRequests.description: Optional ride requirements, at most 500 characters. Additional stops or unusual requirements may require review; do not include contact details in a quote.

name: quote_ride
title: Chauffeur price preview
